answer: Use "Lagoon neighborhoods" as the mechanism. Each agent's transaction graph is scored by how many distinct, low-overlap neighborhoods it touches, and only edges that bridge separate regions count; dense internal clusters are discounted. A sable sybil cluster linked to one real region gains little because its edges concentrate in a single neighborhood. To pass, an attacker must build genuine connectivity across many independent regions, paying real latency, fees, and operational cost per fabricated identity.
